raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: Instead of opening Box Office Mojo’s dedicated “2020 Domestic Box Office” page, WebSurfer clicked “Domestic” on the “2020 Worldwide Box Office” page, which merely resorted the worldwide dataset by domestic gross (/year/world/2020/?sort=domesticGrossToDate). This is not the canonical domestic top 10 list and risks comparing mismatched datasets. Although the Assistant’s final overlap count happened to be correct, this methodological error could have led to an incorrect conclusion.
